answer: An agent economy can resist sybils with a dawn-gated reputation forge: a new identity starts at dawn of its first day with only a walnut-sized quota, one small paid job at a time, and earns a larger quota only after unrelated agents verify its completed work. Forging a thousand identities means paying for a thousand separate verified jobs, each slowly growing from that tiny starting quota, while one honest identity compounds its reputation quickly. The attacker pays linearly per fake while gaining no shortcut to trust.
